CHAP. XLIII. 
 
  Johanan and the commanders discredit Jeremiah's prophecy, ver. 1-3.   and with the people, carry him and Baruch into Egypt, ver. 4-7.   He prophesies by a type, the conquest of Egypt by the   Babylonians, ver. 8-13.
V. 7. Tahpanhes-It was at this time the place where the king of Egypt made his residence.
V. 12. Carry them-He shall carry away both the idols, and the inhabitants of Egypt captive.  With the land-With the spoils of the land of Egypt, he shall clothe his army.
V. 13. Beth-shemesh-Beth-shemesh is the name of a city, which had its name from a famous temple of the sun.
